name: AppleDefenders
summary: Placed plants or towers hit the most advanced enemy in range, face it, play their attack and draw the shot.

needs.defenders: Models in Workspace.AppleDefenders with attributes Range, Damage, Rate, Owner (AppleShop places them); optional Muzzle part or attachment, ShotColor
needs.enemies: Models tagged AppleEnemy with a Health attribute (AppleWaves)

gives.hits: enemy Health lowered, LastHitBy = the owner's UserId
gives.attack: the defender turns to the enemy and gets MotionAttack (AppleMotion animates it)
gives.shots: ReplicatedStorage.AppleShot RemoteEvent; AppleShotClient draws a glowing ball
